description: Phone-only abilities: camera QR scanning (QR-3) and page-turn haptics. Separate from `desktop` because these plugins are compiled in only on iOS/Android (see the target-gated dependencies in Cargo.toml) — naming their permissions in a capability that also applies to desktop fails the build there, since the permission genuinely does not exist. Also carries the shared core/dialog permissions the desktop file has, because the mobile window no longer inherits them from an unrestricted default file.
